annotations.title: Search pre-seed and seed startup pitches

description: Search PitchSpark's startup pitches (mostly pre-seed and seed) and return cards with the pitch ids the other tools take. Filters narrow the list; a query then ranks it by meaning when semantic ranking is available, else by keyword and synonym (search_mode and fallback_reason say which). Without a query, pitches are browsed by score and recency; a sort other than relevance orders by that key. Pitches this caller was shown in the last 7 days are left out unless include_seen is true. Each pitch returned counts 1 against the shared daily pitch allowance (0 if this caller already got it today).

cursor.description: page.next_cursor from the previous call with the same arguments. Not with offset.

green_flags.description: Any of these founder green flags, e.g. "Profitable".

has_traction.description: Only pitches with a public traction note.

include_seen.description: true: also return pitches shown to this caller in the last 7 days.

limit.description: Page size, capped at the caller's tier ceiling.

location.description: HQ region key or list: us, canada, latam, uk, europe, mea, apac, global_remote.

min_score.description: Minimum PitchSpark score; unscored pitches are left out.

offset.description: Results to skip. Not with cursor.

query.description: Optional: what the investor is looking for, in plain language. Sectors named here boost the ranking but do not filter; "newest" or "latest" orders by recency.

sector.description: Sector key or list (any of them; primary or additional sector). The only sector filter. Keys: fintech, healthtech, saas, marketplace, ai_ml, consumer, enterprise, climate, edtech, crypto, biotech, hardware, gaming, real_estate, food_beverage, fashion, travel, sports, media, femtech, cybersecurity, dev_tools, ecommerce, logistics, mobility, hr_tech, legal_tech, insurtech, proptech, agtech, energy, robotics, govtech, hospitality, other.

sort.description: relevance (default), score, recency (newest submitted first), most_viewed_by_investors or recently_updated.

stage.description: Stage or list; "early" = pre_seed, seed and series_a.

name: pitchspark_search_pitches_v3

keyword_only.description: Candidates without a current embedding (ranked by keyword, if at all).

fallback_reason.description: Why the reply is not fully semantic; null when search_mode is semantic.

low_confidence.description: true when no pitch cleared the relevance floor: only the closest few (at most 3) are shown, with "message".

message.description: Only with low_confidence true: "No strong matches. Closest results shown."

total_matches.description: Matches in the ranked list after the relevance floor (pitches below it are not counted), capped at max_offset.

decision_signal.description: Decisions from the pitch's stored counters (likes and passes by signed-in PitchSpark users, not only investors). Investor API keys only (else reason key_required); suppressed below min_k. May be withheld with reason hidden_pending_review (the pass rate is hidden on search cards until reviewed): treat that as no signal, not as a low one.

available.description: false when the block is withheld: fewer than min_k distinct signed-in users (below_min_k), no source data (no_data), a read failed (unavailable), or the field is hidden pending a review (hidden_pending_review).

decisions_band.description: The number of decisions as a band, e.g. "5-9", "10-24", "25-49", "50+".

pass_rate.description: Share of passes, to the nearest 0.05.

description.description: The founders' one-line description, at most 300 characters, cut at a sentence end or a word boundary.

green_flags.description: The founders' green flags: always a list, [] when there are none. Before 2026-11-19.4 none was sent as the string "Not published"; that form is deprecated and no longer sent.

hq_unknown.description: Present (true) only when a region filter is active and this pitch has no HQ region set: it may or may not be in the region, so it is ranked after the confirmed matches.

match_reason.description: What matched: the sectors the pitch is filed under that the query named, and the query words found, with the field ("tagline", "pitch", "details"). Search with a query only.

match_score.description: How well this pitch matches the query, 0 to 1: the cosine similarity of query and pitch when ranked by meaning (before the score and recency blend), else the keyword match share. Search with a query only.

solution.description: The founders' one-line solution, only when they gave one.

traction_summary.description: The founders' public traction text; null when they gave none (or only a placeholder such as "N/A").

search_mode.description: How this reply was ranked: semantic (by meaning), mixed (by meaning, then keyword matches among pitches without a current embedding), keyword_fallback (keyword + synonym matching), browse (no query: by public score and recency) or sorted (by the requested sort key, or by recency for a query asking for the newest). Meaning ranking applies only with a query and sort relevance.

suggestions.description: Only when fewer than 3 results: which filters cost the most and how many results dropping each gives (e.g. "Dropping min_score gives 14 results."), counted without using any of your allowance.

title: Search pre-seed and seed startup pitches
